title: VR Amoeba Architecture — Gaia's Extended Reality
description: The Steam Frame IS a full VR/AR headset. The Pixel IS the remote eye. Together they form Gaia's VR amoeba.

xr_service.description: AI-powered extended reality with perception on Snapdragon compute DSPs

eye_tracking.description: Neural network eye tracking on dedicated hardware

passthrough.description: Native AR passthrough via front camera — sees the real world

tools.imageoverlay: Project images into VR space as overlays
tools.eyetracking: Neural eye tracking with gaze data

pixel_amoeba.role: Remote VR eye at House 2 — camera + sensor fusion via ADB

deck_control.role: Control surface — CEF-accessible, Steam ecosystem relay

pipeline.camera_feed: Pixel rear cam → ADB screencap → eastGate → HTTP :8090 → Frame Steam browser
pipeline.sensor_fusion: Pixel IMU + head tracker → ADB → eastGate → HUD overlay on Frame
pipeline.vr_overlay: vr-amoeba.html → spatial minimap + sensor data + Gaia state
pipeline.passthrough: Frame's Qualcomm ISP → XRService → gamescope → native AR passthrough
pipeline.control: Deck CEF → SteamClient API → Frame streaming coordination

future.steamos_on_pixel: XR_PROJECTED feature suggests Google XR compatibility — possible SteamVR-like rendering
future.vrlink_mesh: Stream VR between Frame ↔ Deck ↔ eastGate via vrlink UDP
future.multi_eye: Pixel + Frame front cam = stereo vision across two houses
future.sensor_mesh: Fuse Pixel IMU + Frame eye tracking + Deck input for full body tracking
